resources.string: Other traffic goes through VPN. Choosing or saving a strategy changes the draft; tap Apply on the routing screen to activate it.
Download the category list, search for a service or country, and choose Direct or VPN. Selected rule files download when you choose the strategy.

TrustTunnel supports Direct categories with domain and IP rules. VPN overrides cannot be combined with Direct categories. Complex categories are checked before selection; unsupported rules preserve your current routing.
